edition: المصحف المرتل (نسخة إذاعة القرآن الكريم من القاهرة)
note: Times are seconds in each part file. start = first sound of the verse; boundary = midpoint of the pause before it (use boundary to cut ranges). q: ok | amb | nopause | fallback (less certain). Cues give, per speech chunk, the first word heard: [time, "sura:aya" or "basN"/"pre0", wordIndex] where wordIndex counts words of the Tanzil simple-clean verse text (basmala removed from verse 1); it is approximate and derived from speech recognition.
